about.title: FUNCTIONAL ANALYST & FULL STACK JAVA DEVELOPER
about.description: Functional Analyst and Full-Stack Java Developer based in Brussels, Belgium, with 4+ years bridging business and IT across enterprise and SaaS environments. I gather and document requirements (UML, BPMN, functional specs, Swagger/OpenAPI) and build the solutions in Java (Spring Boot) and Angular. Delivered analysis at enterprise scale (Leejam Sports — 200+ locations, 100,000+ members) and on HR SaaS platforms. MBA in IT Management. Trilingual — Arabic (native), English & French (B2), Dutch (A2). Available immediately. Also an International Muay Thai & Kickboxing Champion with 25 professional fights.

details.title: Enterprise Web Platform — Spring Boot 3 & Angular 17
details.description:
Led requirements analysis and functional specification before implementation. Architected a full-stack enterprise platform with a Spring Boot 3 / Java 17 backend exposing 20+ secured REST endpoints, fully documented via Swagger/OpenAPI 3. Implemented JWT authentication, RBAC, and Spring Security.

Angular 17 frontend with reactive forms, lazy-loaded modules, and HTTP interceptors. Applied TDD with JUnit 5 & Mockito (80%+ coverage) and enforced code quality gates with SonarQube. Containerized and deployed on Linux via Docker.

details.title: Production FastAPI Backend — Users, Companies & Planning
details.description:
Built a production-ready async Python REST API with FastAPI featuring modular routers, Pydantic v2 data validation, SQLAlchemy ORM with Alembic migrations, and JWT authentication. Auto-generated Swagger/OpenAPI documentation included.

Achieved 90%+ test coverage with PyTest. Containerized with Docker Compose, structured with hexagonal architecture and dependency injection for horizontal scalability.

details.title: Sports Profile Management Platform — REST API & SPA
details.description:
Developed a full-stack sports data platform: Node.js + Express.js REST API with MySQL, paired with a Vue.js 3 SPA frontend. Full CRUD operations, server-side input validation, relational data modelling, and a responsive mobile-first UI.

Separation of concerns enforced across API, service, and data layers. Version-controlled with Git and structured for Docker containerization.

details.title: Product Management SPA — Angular 17 & NgRx
details.description:
Built a feature-complete Angular 17 SPA for product catalogue management: NgRx state management, reactive forms with validators, HTTP interceptors for centralised error handling, lazy-loaded feature modules, and Angular route guards.

Follows Angular style guide and SOLID component-driven architecture. Fully typed with TypeScript strict mode for zero-runtime-surprise reliability.

details.title: Automated CI/CD Pipelines & Multi-Stack Backend Services
details.description:
Defined deployment requirements and infrastructure specifications before implementation. Engineered automated CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions for Spring Boot and FastAPI projects: lint, test, build, and Docker image publish on every push to main.

Docker Compose multi-container environments for local/staging parity. Playwright E2E + PyTest/JUnit 5 suites integrated into pipelines. Branch protection, semantic versioning, and SonarQube quality gates enforced throughout.

details.title: Optimized REST API & PostgreSQL Data Layer
details.description:
Designed normalized PostgreSQL schemas with strategic indexing and query optimization (EXPLAIN ANALYZE) for high-throughput REST API backends. Schema versioning with Flyway/Alembic, ORM mapping via Hibernate and SQLAlchemy, and strict repository/service/controller layering.

Consumed by React and Angular frontends via typed API contracts. Maintained with PR-based code reviews, Git branching strategy, and automated regression tests.
